title: chtypes ABI description, format 2
description: The shape of spec/abi-v2/abi.json: format 1 (spec/abi-v1/schema/abi.schema.json) plus the top-level `stability`, the top-level `inputs` (the closed input documents a growable function takes, rule r1 in spec/abi-v2/docs.md) and a function's `growable`, and `abi` pinned to 2. Structure only: cross-references (a handle's free function exists, a status is a chs_status value, a FIRM function names nothing provisional, docs.md covers every symbol) are checked by scripts/abi-v1/model.py. Uses only the keywords that validator implements; it refuses any other.

abi.description: The ABI generation: CHS_ABI_VERSION, and what chs_abi_version() returns. This description is generation 2's.

stability.description: unstable: the description is still being designed and its fingerprint moves with every change, so only pre-release SDKs speak it. locked: frozen, the fingerprint is fixed, and the generation ships. Inside the fingerprint, so the lock moves it one last time and no unstable build is ever accepted as a locked one.

byte_strings.description: The one rule for every data-derived string a JSON document carries (a column name included), in every output document and in the input column list: the member F is a JSON string when the bytes are valid UTF-8 (a NUL written as an escape), and otherwise the member F + suffix holds the raw bytes in `encoding` (standard base64, padded). Never both. Where a document would hold a bare data-derived string in an array or as an object key, it holds an object instead, so the rule applies to that object's members. `value` names the member that holds a scalar String or FixedString value's raw bytes, beside its rendering. Each document lists its data-derived fields in byte_fields and the entries that carry `value` in value_entries; scripts/abi-v1/model.py checks both against the document's schema.

inputs.description: The input documents: JSON objects a caller passes in a bytes_in parameter whose content is input:<name>. The library refuses a key a document does not define (rule r1), so each schema closes every object; scripts/abi-v1/model.py checks that and r1's shape.

schema.description: A JSON Schema (the subset model.py implements) of the object chs_build_info() returns (D4).

provisional_fields.description: build_info properties whose CONTENT is provisional, though the field itself is FIRM.

markers.description: Present = PROVISIONAL, waiting on each named marker (sdk.json provisional_markers has the legend). Absent = FIRM.

content.description: What a counted byte string carries. Every one is a byte string, never a C string: NUL and invalid UTF-8 pass through. A document:<name> content names an entry in documents, and an input:<name> content an entry in inputs.

closed.description: No value may be added within this ABI generation.

frozen.description: No value may be renumbered or removed.

string_enum.description: A document vocabulary: the strings a JSON document carries, with per-value facts a binding reads instead of deriving.

fallback.description: The value whose per-value facts and answers an unrecognized spelling's unknown(n) member reports (rule r3 in spec/abi-v2/docs.md): the fail-closed arm. A reader keeps the raw value; it never reads it as this value.

value.description: The exact string a document carries: ASCII letters, digits and underscores, and possibly empty (ClickHouse's own spellings, such as a default kind, are kept as ClickHouse spells them).

carries_names.description: The document carries column names, which are byte strings, each carried as byte_strings says.

byte_fields.description: Every data-derived string field of the document, as a path into it: members joined by `.`, and `[]` after a member for each array level. Each is carried by the byte_strings rule.

value_entries.description: The entries (paths ending in `[]`) that report a stored value: each carries the byte_strings `value` member for a scalar String or FixedString value.

schema.description: A JSON Schema (the subset model.py implements) of the fields of the document that the description fixes; a document may carry more, as docs.md describes.

options.description: true: an options document, the one input a growable function takes the inputs it gains in (rule r1), so a later option is a new member here, never a new parameter. false: an input document of fixed purpose (a server profile), which a function may take beside its options document.

schema.description: A JSON Schema (the subset model.py implements) of the document. It closes every object: `additionalProperties: false` on a record, or an `additionalProperties` schema and no `properties` on a map whose keys are data, such as setting or macro names.

thread.description: The thread class; scripts/abi-v1/model.py THREADS describes each, and load() ties it to the function's shape: `shared` exactly when the call reads a caller handle and is not a free, `handle_serial` exactly for a free.

growable.description: Rule r1 in spec/abi-v2/docs.md: true marks a function that may gain inputs after it first ships. It takes exactly one options document (a bytes_in parameter whose content names an inputs entry with options true), and a function not marked growable takes no input document at all; scripts/abi-v1/model.py checks both.
